description: Generic product profile schema for image recognition, catalog tagging, candidate verification, and conversation context.

category.description: Canonical product category key, such as camera, headphones, smartwatch, phone, computer, tablet, keyboard, mouse, digital_other, or shoe.

modelLine.description: Stable model, series, or product line when visible or strongly inferred.

colorway.description: More specific colorway or color combination.

shoeType.description: Only set for shoe products; otherwise null.

size.description: Visible product size or capacity when present; otherwise null.

keywords.description: Short searchable product words, including category, brand, model, and visible attributes.

subjectDetection.description: Optional product subject detection metadata in normalized 0-1 coordinates.
